text: Steve Shaw, Executive Officer, Facility Services, Sustainability and Planning, Toronto District School Board (TDSB) will give a presentation on the TDSB's Consultation on Community Use of Board Facilities. The Community Use of Board Facilities Policy supports the Toronto District School Board’s commitment to optimizing use and accessibility of TDSB facilities for community groups and organizations through a permit process that promotes fair and equitable opportunity. The Policy is aligned with the Ministry of Education’s Community Use of Schools Program and Section 171(1) para 24 of the Education Act, which allows TDSB to permit school buildings and premises owned by the TDSB to be used for any educational or other lawful purposes.
The City-School Boards Advisory Committee received the item for information.
